tok 1.0 "Invoice approval"

pool acme "ACME AG"
  lane sec "Secretariat"
    start s "Invoice received"
    task receive "Receive the invoice"
    task inspect "Inspect the invoice visually"
    task forward "Forward the invoice to the accounting employee"
  lane acc "Accounting employee"
    task identify "Identify the supplier and create the invoice instance"
    task checkitems "Check the invoice items and note cost centers on the docket"
    xor sendm
    task send "Send the docket and invoice copy to the cost center manager"
    task clarify "Clarify the inconsistencies with the vendor"
    task forwardcm "Forward the invoice copy to the commercial manager"
    xor payjoin
    task resolve "Resolve the complaint with the supplier"
    xor auditm
    task pay "Give payment instructions"
    task close "Close the instance"
    end e "Invoice processed"
  lane ccm "Cost center manager"
    task review "Review the invoice content"
    xor ok "Everything in order?"
    task ap "Note the AP code on the docket"
    xor more "All positions marked AP?"
    task reject "Reject the AP with a note and statement"
  lane com "Commercial manager"
    task audit "Make the commercial audit"
    xor complaint "Complaint?"
    task approve "Issue the approval for payment"
    xor big "Amount exceeds EUR 20?"
  lane board "Board"
    task boardcheck "Check the invoice again"

flow s -> receive -> inspect -> forward -> identify -> checkitems -> sendm -> send -> review -> ok
flow ok -> ap "yes"
flow ok -> reject "no"
flow ap -> more
flow more -> review "no"
flow more -> forwardcm "yes"
flow reject -> clarify -> sendm
flow forwardcm -> auditm -> audit -> complaint
flow complaint -> resolve "yes"
flow resolve -> auditm
flow complaint -> approve "no"
flow approve -> big
flow big -> boardcheck "yes"
flow big -> payjoin "no" default
flow boardcheck -> payjoin
flow payjoin -> pay -> close -> e
